text:
Ivy Chen: hey team, day 1 q: where should i drop different asks? laptop/provisioning errors vs product q's vs quick team FYIs. also—best practice for muting noisy bots but keeping pagers?

Omar Malik: Welcome! quick map: 
- hardware/provisioning -> #help (use short template)
- infra/deploy -> #eng-infra
- product/context -> #product
- team updates/status -> your team channel, then reply in thread for any back-and-forth

Priya S.: Template for #help that speeds things up: "Name / Team / What I need / Error or screenshot / Urgency (low|med|high)". Paste CLI output for infra tickets.

Sam T.: For bot noise: don't mute channels blindly. Open channel > View apps > find the bot > change "notify only on failures" or toggle what events notify. Also set personal keywords (your name, "pager") so mobile only pings on important stuff.

DevEx Bot: Hi Ivy! :wave: Helpful commands: 
```
/onboard subscribe-digest    # get daily onboarding highlights as a DM
/onboard unsubscribe
/dnd 22:00-07:00             # set quiet hours
```
To mute DeployBot in a channel without losing failures: channel > Integrations > DeployBot > set to "only on failures". Never mute #eng-oncall or @oncall.

OnboardBot: If you want a buddy reply "buddy please" or run `/onboard assign-buddy`. If you're blocked on access post in #help with the template above and tag the person listed on the access matrix.

Ivy Chen: perfect, thanks! i'll post access requests in #help and infra errors in #eng-infra. buddy please :)

Omar Malik: i'll DM you later today to help with SSH + Docker setup. :)

Priya S.: pro tip: use reactions for ack (thumbsup) instead of throwing another message; keeps channels readable.

Ivy Chen: love that. thanks all :heart:
